For whoever runs the office

Whether it's you at night or someone at a desk all day — Office is where the business side gets done in minutes instead of evenings.

What it does

What Office does

Pipeline

Every lead in one place. Log the call, send the estimate, convert the win into a client and a job without retyping anything.

Production Board

Every job on one board: Scheduled → In Progress → Punch List → Complete → Paid in Full. Jobs that sit too long flag themselves.

Money dashboard

Invoiced vs. collected, what's still owed, and which clients owe it — by month or by week.

Follow-ups that don't slip

Automatic reminders when an estimate goes quiet, an invoice goes overdue, or a finished job is ready for a review request.

Promotions

Send a clean, professional email to past clients — or just the ones who got an estimate and never closed — without a separate marketing tool.

Proposals that report back

See when a client opens your estimate, and get a nudge when they open it again.

QuickBooks sync

Clients, invoices, and payments flow both ways. No double entry.

Get paid from the invoice

Clients pay by card or bank transfer right from the invoice link, and the payment records itself. (Pro feature, connects through Stripe.)

Your crew, their logins

Team accounts with the right access for each person — who can see money, who can send documents, who just sees their jobs.
